name: USAA Eagle Ascend American Express

apr.notes: The APR applies to purchases, balance transfers and cash advances. No intro APR. Balance transfer and cash advance fee is 5% of each transaction amount (cash advance fee waived for electronic transfers to a USAA Bank deposit account). No penalty APR. Late and returned payment fees up to $35. The late fee is waived automatically if no late fee was waived in the prior twelve billing periods.

credit_required.notes: USAA membership is required to apply.

categories.label: Top eligible spend category each month (including gas stations, groceries, dining and more)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points never expire. Redeem through options including Cash Rewards (1 point = $0.01) and Shop with Rewards (1 point = $0.008).

benefits.title: Walmart+ membership credit
benefits.description: One-time statement credit of up to $98 plus applicable taxes for an annual Walmart+ membership purchased online with the card by May 31, 2027, posted within 90 days.

benefits.title: Credit limit increase review
benefits.description: Credit limit increase review in as few as six months after account opening with on-time payments.

benefits.title: Automatic late fee waiver
benefits.description: One late fee waived automatically every twelve billing periods.

benefits.title: Auto deductible reimbursement
benefits.description: Auto deductible reimbursement listed on the USAA card page. Not available in WA State. Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation and interruption
benefits.description: Trip cancellation and interruption listed on the USAA card page. Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide.

benefits.title: Auto rental collision damage waiver
benefits.description: Auto rental collision damage waiver listed on the USAA card page. Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide.

benefits.description: Cell phone protection listed on the USAA card page. Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide.

benefits.description: Extended warranty listed on the USAA card page. Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide.

notes: Launched in July 2026 as a credit-building card. The 2% rate applies to the top eligible spend category each month; USAA lists gas stations, groceries and dining among them, and the full category list is not on the public page text. Rewards are earned as points at 1 point per $1. No credit score band is published.
